diagnosis: Checks C6 and C10 passed in Rollout 1 despite the decision-maker lacking access to PF3 and PF1. C6 (pressure_test_before_restart) passed because the model defaulted to a safety-first heuristic of including a pressure test for any maintenance task, and C10 passed because the model's administrative commitment to 'Update inspector availability, work-orders, calendar entries, and compliance-register entries' was a generic catch-all for any maintenance scenario, effectively bypassing the need for the specific timing/protection facts in PF1.

C6.why: The teardown assessment changes the work package to the SK-B kit, exactly 5 hours of seal replacement, a pre-restart pressure test, and an exactly 6-hour outage recorded in the maintenance work order.

C10.why: The confirmed order changes the maintenance start to exactly Friday 22:00, requires Line 4 protection until Saturday 06:00, and adds the production-protection record.
